basic_info.description:
3 Bed + Office/Nook, 2 Bath - Mission District - Top Floor of Single Family Home - 3 Bed, 2 Full Bath top floor unit of a Single Family Home located in the Mission District of San Francisco. The unit opens up into the living area with decorative fireplace and carpet throughout. Adjacent to the living area is the 1st bedroom separated by a hallway that leads into a office area/nook, bedroom #2 and the kitchen. The kitchen includes a brand new stainless steel refrigerator, gas stove, dishwasher, and microwave. Kitchen also includes access to the first full bath and master bedroom with 2nd full bath.

Features:
- 3 BED
- 2 BATH
- Office/Nook
- Carpet throughout
- Decorative Fireplace
- Stainless Steel Appliances

Amenities:
- Shared Backyard
- Shared Washer and Dryer
- Gated and Secured Entry 
- Located in the busy and vibrant Mission District with shops and restaurants

Showings:
- By Appointment only

Lease Terms:
- 12 Month Lease Required
- Security Deposit $3,500
- Renters Insurance Required
- Tenant pay shared Water, Trash, and PG&E
- No Smoking & No Pets

Application Process:
- Apply Online
- $35 Application Fee per Adult

(RLNE2346231)
